notes.content:

- [b]Rally[/b]: when a cat is summoned 
- [b]Water Rally[/b]: when a water cat is summoned 
- [b]Summon[/b]: when you summon the actual card.

[i]Dev notes: noticed there where a few cards that had Rally on their effects but didnt match what how they trigger so I created the Summon effect. [/i]

[h3]Balance ⚖️[/h3]

[i]Dev notes: For the synergy update it will give more freeway to mix electric cards with other types[/i]

notes.title: Sinergies Update coming next week
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I wanted to take a moment to share a bit of my journey with you all, especially with those who've supported Spellcats. Over the past few months, a lot has changed for me on a personal level, both in terms of lifestyle and job responsibilities. Even though I don’t have as much free time now, I’m still fully committed to improving Spellcats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/587a56ce2876f7e10777166fec2476ad83bd6ec6.png[/img]

Looking forward, I’ll be rolling out smaller updates and bug fixes as I tackle the larger, more complex features like the element synergies. You can expect these changes to come in incremental patches starting [b]next week[/b]. I know there's a lot to do, and as a one-person team juggling many responsibilities, your patience and understanding mean a lot to me.

Thank you for your support, and apologies for the wait. You’ve been incredibly understanding, and I assure you it will be worth it as we continue building Spellcats together.

Regards,
Johan Croix

notes.title: Version 1.2.0 is Out!
notes.content:
Patch 1.2.0 is Live!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/587a56ce2876f7e10777166fec2476ad83bd6ec6.png[/img]

[h3]Quality of Life 🌱[/h3]

[list]
[*] We've improved card handling and animations! Now, moving and dragging cards with the mouse feels much smoother and more intuitive. This was a major pain point for many of you, so we dedicated two weeks to revamp the UI system. The effort has paid off, and it feels fantastic!
[/list]

Looking ahead, I have two major tasks to tackle next:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/587a56ce2876f7e10777166fec2476ad83bd6ec6.png[/img]

First, I'll focus on creating more card synergies, especially freeing up the exclusive effects of the electric and water cards to enable some nastier combos. After that, I'll work on increasing the game's difficulty to provide more challenging runs for those of you looking for a tougher experience!

If you encounter any issues, please let me know on our Discord server! I'm prioritizing the most critical bugs since I'm handling this solo.

Regards,
Johan Croix

notes.title: Fixes Are Incoming! New Patch Every Saturday!
notes.content:
Hey Spellcats community,

We've heard your feedback loud and clear – thank you for sticking with us through the glitches! 🐾✨ In our commitment to improving your gameplay experience, we've decided to adjust our patch schedule.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/161cf6c820afdaa0a8ef0f40da14e4628fdc9ddc.png[/img]

While the enthusiasm to fix issues quickly led us to release daily updates last week, it also meant some bugs slipped through without proper testing. We're taking a new approach: rather than rushing, we're dedicating the entire workweek to develop, test, and ensure the quality of each patch.

Expect a new, polished update rolling out every Saturday. This way, we can deliver the fixes you need and the quality you deserve.

Thanks for your patience and passion. Let's make Spellcats better, together! 


Best wishes,
Johan Croix

notes.title: Meet Tom
notes.content:
Meet Tom, the yellow cat who appeared in front of my house on Christmas day 10 years ago. We adopted him immediately, and he's been a beloved member of our family ever since!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/93ecbd6307d2033affda2dfcc1e84e886eae044b.jpg[/img]

Tom is quite the character. He's incredibly lazy - you'll often find him lounging on a windowsill or curled up in a cozy spot, taking yet another nap. But despite his laziness, he's absolutely adorable. He has big, bright eyes and a fluffy tail that he'll twitch when he's particularly content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/1c7ced5c1154b7aed980c43948a5542f316bef7f.jpg[/img]

One thing that's always on Tom's mind is food. Whether he's begging for scraps at the dinner table or snooping around the kitchen looking for a snack, he's always thinking about his next meal. And let's be real, with that cute little face, it's hard to say no to him!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/75081e06fe4d181312756ae4702b7cc6b80e1a86.jpg[/img]

Tom can be a bit of a rascal at times, too. As a yellow cat, he's got that mischievous streak that seems to come with the territory. He'll sometimes knock things over or swat at objects just to see what happens. But despite his occasional antics, we can't help but love him all the same.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/d8372749435f80063df569de31cf0cd51547f912.jpg[/img]

Now that Tom is 10 years old, he's definitely slowing down a bit. He doesn't have quite the same energy he used to, but that's okay - we're happy to give him all the love and attention he deserves in his golden years.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/e246b45da9c9d006ab7a62599640f4ff4bfd47f5.jpg[/img]

All in all, Tom is a wonderful cat who has brought so much joy to our family over the past decade. We're so grateful to have him in our lives, and we wouldn't have it any other way!

notes.title: Which element describes best your personality ?
notes.content:
Welcome to the world of [b]Nekomancer[/b], where you can summon powerful elemental cats to aid you on your quest! Each neko has its own unique traits and abilities, reflecting the elemental energy it embodies. In this post, we'll explore the different personalities and traits of the five main elemental nekomancer types: electric, fire, water, ice, and ground. Read on to discover which [b]elemental nekomancer best represents your personality and strengths![/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/d5e9feb46bfcb884db315d77cf17a2f88f9f5628.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/dd6e71f51f40490c07137a6432dc71eec24e60b8.png[/img][/url]
[b]Electric Nekomancer: [/b]These nekomancers are full of energy and have a vibrant personality. They are quick thinkers and are always on the move. They tend to be impulsive, but they can also be incredibly charming. They have a natural ability to attract people and are often the life of the party.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/e41e64f1f651365db3ea3218ba70a6166bdbee48.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/639f075b96c92e676e496b78f30092b1b34e57af.png[/img][/url]
[b]Fire Nekomancer:[/b] These nekomancers are passionate and fierce. They have a strong will and are not afraid to stand up for what they believe in. They are driven and determined, and they have a contagious energy that inspires those around them. They can also be hot-headed and stubborn, but they are always loyal to those they care about.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/19ec90e56b47fe31d0603944e9d960b97c07d162.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/0d5a37194fa9f26cdd08b8c37c114281bb61108a.png[/img][/url]
[b]Water Nekomancer:[/b] These nekomancers are calm and collected. They have a gentle nature and are often empathetic and intuitive. They are great listeners and have a natural ability to put others at ease. They are also adaptable and can navigate any situation with ease. However, they can be sensitive and may struggle with emotional boundaries.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/2a69c1676f3a1979e053e54f4a6537883643708f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/02ba417de526d86fac91889367d5d5a18c6f38d9.png[/img][/url]
[b]Ice Nekomancer: [/b]These nekomancers are cool and collected. They have a sharp wit and are quick thinkers. They tend to keep to themselves and can come off as aloof or distant, but they are also incredibly loyal to those they consider friends. They are great problem solvers and have a natural ability to see things from multiple perspectives.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/49d54a861e8b0952063a5c4efe8b8700904f0820.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/bf75aa27e44e03b731c823866397d1bc2afdbd18.png[/img][/url]
[b]Ground Nekomancer: [/b]These nekomancers are stable and dependable. They have a grounded nature and are often practical and reliable. They have a strong work ethic and are always willing to lend a helping hand. They can also be stubborn and resistant to change, but they are always willing to listen to others' opinions and ideas.

Each neko type has its own strengths and weaknesses, but all are valuable allies on your quest to become a powerful nekomancer. Whether you're drawn to the fiery passion of the fire nekomancer or the calming nature of the water nekomancer, there's an elemental cat out there that's [b]purrfect[/b] for you. So summon your nekos, embrace your elemental energy, and let your journey begin!

notes.title: A Cat with human brain ?
notes.content:
[h1]Does it has a Human brain?[/h1]

[b]Spoiler: [/b]it doesn't. Nekomancer is set in a world where humans use "Nekos" for their own benefit, and as the only sentient cat, it's up to you to uncover the mystery of your kind.

[h1]Designing the Cat Protagonist for Nekomancer: A Roguelike Game[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/8c275096925603f038b5c54a572831dcb2f82ad3.png[/img]

Hey there, I'm Johan a gamedev and cat lover here. I'm working on a new game called Nekomancer, a roguelike deckbuilder where you play as a clever cat mage with the ability to summon other cats to your side. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/b6072cae3dff9e0840684c64e3086b16c9836faf.png[/img]

Designing the protagonist was super fun, I wanted to make sure they were relatable but also unique. I made some draft and a close friend made some early concepts of "NEKO" (it's name is pending)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/5f2b9f908fde88f4ba730626f882f8e18457dc01.png[/img]

Later in almost a year I reached out to an artist called zeoarts ([url=https://twitter.com/zeolandia]twitter[/url]) to help with the character design and key art for steam. Their concept art is killer. Can't wait for you guys to check it out when it's ready! Stay tuned for more updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281069/24bbecd1908669aca56b9cde243a9a8ceca8655a.jpg[/img]


[b]BTW do you have any name suggestions ? here's a simple list of what we have in mind 
[/b]

[list]
[*]Obi
[*]Cherub
[*]Pixie
[*]Revenant 
[*]Akuba: "Witch" in Japanese.
[*]Renneverate
[/list]
